source.notes: Mixed-provenance schematic from supplied MD6 drawing 3223 v10-a, page 2. Footprint 127.76 x 85.46 mm is dimensioned. The visible innermost circular contour, pitch and A1 datum are measured from PDF vector linework after independent X/Y calibration to that footprint: visible inner diameter about 34.6 mm, pitch about 40.0 mm, A1 about (23.9,22.7) in landscape orientation with A1 upper-left. These are drawing-measurement estimates rounded to 0.1 mm, not manufacturer-specified opening dimensions; the plan view does not unambiguously identify top vs bottom internal diameter. See docs/measurements/nunc-140675.json and scripts/measure_nunc_6.py. Original chamfers/steps simplified. assumed_fields records every unverified dimension.
